item.title: International Yoga Day
item.description:
About 7500 people joined the First International Day of Yoga in Bangkok. The mass event showcased the yoga protocol demonstration for peace and harmony. Congratulations to the Embassy of India in Bangkok for organizing such as wonderful event under the leadership of H.E. Shri Harsh V Shringla, Ambassador of India to Thailand. Saraff group was one of the main sponsors for this event.

item.title: Fun Fair in Thailand
item.description:
The Thai-Indian Fun Fair was an event organised by the Indian Social Club of Thailand to bring together the Thai and Indian communities living in Thailand. Saraff Group has been an important part of organising this event since it was started in 2014. We at Saraff Group sponsor this event and participate in organizing it effectively.

item.title: Eye Camp
item.description:
Mr. Susheel Kumar Saraff had organised an eye camp at their trust in Orissa. Where many people in that area where treated for free and taken care of. People were provided with good eye test and advices on keeping their eyes safe. This initiative was sponsored by Saraff Group.

item.title: Shree Dadiji Mandir Trust Prabhavathi Public School
item.description:
Shree Dadiji Mandir Trust Prabhavathi Public School has been started with an objective to impart quality education to the pupils of educationally and economically backward KBK region at an affordable cost. Sri Susheel Saraff, the Chairperson of the trust has encouraged the school to process every year by leaps and bounds.

item.title: Flood Donation
item.description:
A large number of volunteers,vehicles and ambulances took part in rescue operation at different area’s - helping find and rescue victims,administered first aid and ran evacuation center. Thousands of people where provided with Food, Shelter, Clean Water, Sanitation and Medical care.

item.title: Festivals of India
item.description: Festivals in India are an integral part of people’s life in India. The numerous and varied festivals that are held throughout the year offers a unique way of seeing India. India celebrates holidays and festivals of almost all the faiths of the world.Each festival are an integral part of people’s life. Festivals of India enrich’s India’s culture and Tradition.
